newsitem.title: USA: FOCUS-Bullish API crude vies with bearish products.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Bullish API crude vies with bearish products.

text.p: A bullish big draw in crude stocks last week vied for market sway with bearishly large builds in oil products inventories in the American Petroleum Institute's latest weekly report Tuesday evening.
"This is bearish for the crack spreads, that's pretty simple and transparent," said Tim Evans, an energy analyst at Pegasus Econometrics, a unit of Thomson Financial.
"What is tougher to assess is whether the bearishness of the products will outweigh the bullish crude data. I think the crude data is the bigger surprise," he added.
